feature-expansion.introduction: Signpost is an internal link-shortening service: turn a long URL into a stable short code, and turn a short code back into a redirect.

feature.name: Redirect resolution
feature.intent: Resolve a short code to its target URL and record the click, even when the target itself is unreachable.

feature.name: Link administration
feature.intent: Validate a target URL, mint a short code, and let an owner retire a link later.
